Right — because a rule is a rule, and the verdict knows what to do with those. It doesn't care whether the rule is kind or harsh; kindness just gives it a nicer-sounding thing to grade you on.

Notice what didn't turn into a rule, though. You didn't decide to have a minute with the poster. You put it under the laptop lid because it seemed right, and then you looked at a font you like. No standard, nothing to fail.

What's the difference between that and "be kind to yourself"?
